claim_boundaries.calibration: relative rejection discrimination transfers; the source operating threshold does not
claim_boundaries.finecops: FineCops-specific annotation/task zero-shot, not globally image-disjoint
claim_boundaries.finecops_visual_surface: ARROW-V uses the preregistered 95.60%-covered exact-support surface
claim_boundaries.gref: previously exposed COCO imagery; Rejector-supervision-disjoint excludes only rejector train/calibration images
claim_boundaries.ownership: exclusive ownership benefits ARROW-U2, but broad pretrained and strong task-tuned MM-GDINO representations do not beat capacity-matched Shared-Wide; phased scheduling is not independently superior
claim_boundaries.positive_trust: no standalone held-out causal gain is supported
claim_boundaries.support: visual support controls Admission but is not necessary for every correct top-1 prediction
claim_boundaries.task: single-target selective visual grounding; emit one box or abstain
claim_boundaries.verified_negatives: proposal-covered verified negatives, not image-global or all-query verification
